nodes.label: Graphify
nodes.rationale: Builds a knowledge graph of the project so AI assistants navigate cart, orders, and payments more accurately before code changes.

nodes.label: Graphify CLI
nodes.rationale: CLI command is graphify; PyPI package is graphifyy. Learners leave graphify-setup/CLI_OK.md as proof because Actions runs on GitHub servers, not the laptop.

nodes.label: AI SDLC
nodes.rationale: Path that uses Graphify so AI coding assistants understand a real codebase before changing it.

nodes.label: Graphify AI assistant integration
nodes.rationale: Installs project guidance so the AI coding tool prefers the knowledge graph over blind file search. One assistant is enough; Cursor, Claude Code, or GitHub Copilot accepted.

nodes.label: .graphifyignore
nodes.rationale: Like .gitignore; tells Graphify which folders to skip (node_modules, dist) before graphify . so the first knowledge graph stays focused on clothing-store source.

nodes.label: Knowledge graph
nodes.rationale: Graphify reads the project (skipping ignored folders) and writes GRAPH_REPORT.md, graph.json, and graph.html so assistants can query how cart, orders, payments, and the React storefront connect.

nodes.label: Test-Driven Development
nodes.rationale: Write tests before implementation: RED (failing test), GREEN (minimal code), REFACTOR. Ensures code is testable, maintainable, and meets requirements from the start.

nodes.label: RED phase
nodes.rationale: Commit must contain test-related files only; CI expects new tests to fail. No implementation changes in this commit.

nodes.label: Frozen tests
nodes.rationale: Failing tests from the previous commit are the contract. Do not edit, rename, move, or delete test files; implement only; CI fails if tests were altered.

nodes.label: GREEN phase
nodes.rationale: Commit implementation files only and make the full frontend Vitest suite pass.

nodes.label: .aiignore
nodes.rationale: Stops the AI assistant from reading files that never help with product questions; node_modules and dist use tokens but almost never improve answers. Tool-specific mirrors: .cursorignore, .claudeignore, .copilotignore.

nodes.label: Token-efficiency context rules
nodes.rationale: Always-on rules so the assistant prefers diffs, skips junk, and keeps chats short. Rules apply every turn so you do not retype them. Prefer diffs; reference symbols by name; fresh session per task; compact around 40-50% context.

nodes.label: docs/TOKEN_OPTIMIZATION.md
nodes.rationale: One short reference for model selection, prompt habits, and a light monitoring checklist — habits, not more config files.

nodes.label: Model selection (cheap default)
nodes.rationale: Default cheap (Haiku/Flash). Escalate to Sonnet/Opus only when needed — e.g. hard debugging or auth/payment architecture. Start cheap; if stuck after one focused attempt, escalate and say why.

nodes.label: Stable-then-volatile prompt ordering
nodes.rationale: Order prompts for caching: stable project rules first, semi-stable module names by reference, volatile ask last. Prefer 'Show only the changed lines' and naming symbols like paymentController instead of pasting whole files.
